channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Lighting project returns over $282K in rebates to APS
item.description: Project is estimated to save the district around $177,737 each year

item.title: The science of satiety
item.description: Discover how protein, fiber, healthy fats, gut health and mindful eating work together to keep you fuller longer—and how a dietitian can help you build satisfying meals.

item.title: Mower County signs on to support SMMPA legislative request
item.description: Mower County backs SMMPA bid for a tax break on gas-fired equipment at an $85M Austin power plant, projected to start construction in 2027 and generate over $100,000 in taxes.

item.title: Tree clearing work begins for Austin pedestrian bridge over Cedar River near I-90
item.description: MnDOT crews are clearing trees along Austin's Cedar River to prepare for a new pedestrian-bike bridge north of I-90; trail stays mostly open with brief closures through April 15.

item.title: Triple threat: BP juniors continue to leave their mark on the program as Blossoms down Falcons
item.description: BP juniors Rafdal, Kingston Lee and Staloch star in a 54-50 win over Wabasha-Kellogg, as Rafdal breaks the school 3-point season record and Lee closes in on the rebounds mark.

item.title: Packer boys hockey team falls to New Ulm
item.description: Flanders scores twice to pull Austin even in the third, but New Ulm answers with three straight in a 5-2 win, dropping the Packers to 9-16.

item.title: Shorthanded Viking girls take down Fillmore Central
item.description: Shorthanded Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy edged Fillmore Central 51-47 on the road, led by 23 points from Lily Morrisey while missing Jenna Christopherson and Betsy Gillette.

item.title: Schwarz hits six threes as BP girls win big
item.description: Claire Schwarz drains six threes and scores 20 as Blooming Prairie tops Alden-Conger/Glenville-Emmons 66-49 on the road.

item.title: Koenigs leads Rebel girls over Pine Island
item.description: Brynlee Koenigs posts 17 points and 10 rebounds as Southland beats Pine Island 60-34 in Adams; Avery Stroup adds 14 points and seven rebounds for the Rebels.

item.title: Dahle's double double paces Vikings past Loyola
item.description: Austin Dahle’s 10-point, 12-rebound double-double leads Hayfield to a 61-56 home win over Mankato Loyola, with Drew Slaathaug adding 17 as the Vikings move to 14-8.
